subject: history
title: Partition of Bengal (1905, 1911, 1947)
description: First Partition 1905, Annulment 1911, Second Partition 1947 — with tricks and key points

content.overview: Bengal was partitioned twice — first in 1905 by Lord Curzon (annulled in 1911), and again in 1947 during the Partition of India.
keyPoints: FIRST PARTITION (1905): Announced by Lord Curzon, effective 16 October 1905
Official reason: administrative convenience; Real reason: divide the growing influence of Bengalis and nationalism
Division: East Bengal & Assam (Muslim majority, capital Dacca) | West Bengal (Hindu majority, capital Calcutta)
Opposition: Strong protest — Swadeshi Movement started as a response
ANNULMENT (1911): Announced by King George V on 12 December 1911 at Delhi Durbar
Reason for annulment: Strong protest and Swadeshi Movement
Result: Partition annulled, Bengal reunited; Capital shifted from Calcutta to Delhi
SECOND PARTITION (1947): During Partition of India, based on religious majority
West Bengal → India (Hindu majority); East Bengal → East Pakistan (Muslim majority)
Result: Massive displacement of millions of people

mnemonics.explanation: Curzon's real motive behind partitioning Bengal in 1905: Divide (Bengalis), Distract (nationalists), Dominate (weaken nationalism)

mnemonics.trick: R.E.U.N.I.T.E.D = Reunited Bengal, Ended partition 1911, United people's protest, National leaders fought, Indians were united, Together we won, End of Curzon's evil plan, Delhi became capital
mnemonics.explanation: 1911 annulment — Bengal reunited after united protests; Delhi became the new capital

mnemonics.trick: H.I.M.S. = Hindus stayed in India, India got West Bengal, Muslims went to Pakistan, Shift of millions of people
mnemonics.explanation: 1947 partition — West Bengal to India, East Bengal to East Pakistan, massive population displacement

quiz.question: The First Partition of Bengal was announced by:
quiz.explanation: Lord Curzon announced the First Partition of Bengal in 1905, effective 16 October 1905

quiz.question: The Partition of Bengal was annulled in:
quiz.explanation: King George V announced the annulment on 12 December 1911 at the Delhi Durbar; capital shifted to Delhi

quiz.question: After the 1905 partition, the capital of East Bengal & Assam was:
quiz.explanation: Dacca (Dhaka) was the capital of East Bengal & Assam after the 1905 partition

quiz.question: Which movement started in response to the 1905 Partition of Bengal?
quiz.explanation: The Swadeshi Movement started in response to the Partition of Bengal in 1905

Partition annulled; capital shifted to Delhi
